scenicChapters.title: Jektvik → Glomfjord
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 80 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

norwegian-scenic-route-helgelandskysten.story: A one-way ride of 544 km, Vik to Inndyr - roughly 7 h 20 in the saddle. The stops in between: Bronnoysund, Sandnessjoen, Jektvik and Glomfjord. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
